about_the_game:
Survive the storm. Face the unknown.
When the Sun Dies is a post-apocalyptic survival game where every night hides something more dangerous than hunger or cold. Explore vast forests, deserts, and snowy wastelands, gather resources, and fight to stay alive as the world collapses into chaos.

Radstorm: A Deadly Twist on Survival
Unlike traditional survival games, When the Sun Dies introduces the Radstorm, a catastrophic radioactive storm that turns the night into a battlefield. Monsters grow stronger, radiation spreads, and every kill drops rare stones that can enhance your weapons with powerful abilities. Will you risk everything to face the storm—or hide until it passes?

Craft, Fight, and Adapt
Instead of relying on random loot boxes, you’ll earn your weapons through quests and crafting. Collect materials, complete small missions, and forge unique weapons—each axe, spear, or rifle can have different stats, making your choices matter in every fight.

A Living, Breathing World

  • Dynamic weather and seasons: fog, rain, snow, and temperature changes keep you on edge.

  • Open world exploration: forests, rivers, mountains, and hidden ruins await.

  • NPC quests: rescue survivors, find lost items, and earn rewards.

  • Weapon customization: upgrade your gear with over 40 possible stats.

Every Decision Counts
In When the Sun Dies, survival is not just about food and water—it’s about courage. Do you fight through the Radstorm for glory and rare loot, or play it safe and risk falling behind?

content_descriptors.notes:
Prepare for the ultimate fight for survival in When The Sun Dies, a brutal and unforgiving post-apocalyptic world where every decision matters. As humanity teeters on the brink, you'll face relentless threats, scavenge for dwindling resources, and battle against grotesque creatures twisted by the cataclysm.

Key Features:

Harrowing Survival: Endure hunger, thirst, and the elements as you struggle to stay alive in a desolate landscape.

Intense Combat: Engage in visceral, close-quarters combat against mutated horrors and desperate survivors. Every encounter is a fight for your life.

Uncover the Darkness: Explore a vast, ruined world filled with secrets, dangers, and the lingering echoes of a fallen civilization.

Craft and Build: Utilize a deep crafting system to create essential tools, weapons, and shelters to defend yourself against the encroaching night.

Mature Content Warning: When The Sun Dies features intense violence, graphic blood, and unsettling creature design that may not be suitable for all players. Player discretion is advised.

Will you rise above the ashes or be consumed by the darkness when the sun dies?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 / AMD Radeon R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 / AMD Radeon RX 580 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 MB available space

short_description: When the Sun Dies is an open-world survival game set in a mysterious post-apocalyptic world, where players explore deadly biomes, survive radiation storms, and upgrade their weapons to face what lies beyond the fog.
